title: 'Paranormal Episode': Clarke Historical Museum in Eureka hosts several Halloween-inspired events
excerpt: On Oct. 23 and 24, a ghost tour is planned at the museum, 240 E St., and on Oct. 30, “The Clarke Historical Museum Humboldt Paranormal Episode, Part One.”
content:
The Clarke Historical Museum in Eureka is hosting two special Halloween programs.

On Oct. 23 and 24, a ghost tour is planned at the museum, 240 E St., and on Oct. 30, “The Clarke Historical Museum Humboldt Paranormal Episode, Part One,” by Ruben W. Botello of Paranormal Humboldt will be screened at the museum. The tours and screening are rated PG-13.

The screening will be followed by a Q&A with Botello, who led the most recent paranormal investigation of the Clarke Museum in January, 2025. Doors open at 6:30 p.m., and the screening starts at 7 p.m. Tours are 45 minutes, and include stairs and low light. Spaces are limited and by reservation only. Tours are at 6, 7 and 8 p.m. both evenings.

“The Clarke Historical Museum Humboldt Paranormal Episode, Part One” explores the eerie history of the museum building and its location in Old Town, along with accounts from museum staff describing their possible paranormal encounters. Viewers will also see a spirit medium conduct a walkthrough of the building, share her readings, and explain how paranormal activity is interpreted.

To purchase advance tickets for these events, go to https://www.clarkemuseum.org or call 707-443-1947.
